Teach commands through prerequisites, expected outputs and failure interpretation. Distinguish recorded demonstrations from operations actually executed for this course. decision: Build one Codex-authored, chaptered v3 full course targeting 60 minutes, with acceptance based on 58–65 minutes of measured playback. Use a worked journey supported by a complete file-level companion, substantive paper coverage and explanations of both CSVs. Author modular chapters and assemble one continuous course. Complete the mandatory read-only preflight before edits; this draft does not establish that the uninspected pipeline satisfies its requirements. Stage and verify before replacing current navigation. Preserve historical releases, protected evidence and the retired /course/ route. Human full-watch and all-caption acceptance remain explicitly pending and are not, by themselves, publication blockers under this new v3 standard. Known material defects block publication. Ordinary root implementation proceeds under standing authorization without approval pauses; binaries and external publication are outside broker file delivery.
dissent: The teaching design and v3 acceptance principles are shared. Fable considers mandatory Phase-0 inspection sufficient to resolve the missing-evidence objection at design time; Codex retains the implementation-specific objection until the complete requested implementations and applicable prior technical blockers are inspected. This draft therefore makes no unconditional commitment to pipeline reuse and does not claim that the evidence gap is closed. Exact legacy verification invocations remain dependent on that inspection. Naming differences are nonblocking; 'v3 full course' is adopted.

findings.summary: Publication must preserve protected historical assets and the customer ZIP's latest-release destination. Successful v3 checks cannot change the prior ESCALATED/UNRATIFIED outcome or establish a human watch-through.

reasons: A worked journey builds the explanation a beginner must deliver. A directory-order lecture fragments that explanation; the reconciled companion supplies individual-file depth.

Separate short videos improve production convenience but do not meet the single-course request. Modular authoring followed by one assembled video provides both manageable production and one active lesson.
Codex authorship and disclosed synthetic speech rendering are compatible without a dedicated speech API credential.
Measured timing, substantive content review and media diagnostics provide an achievable acceptance standard while preserving the limits of automated verification.
Versioned sources, a separate receipt and additive non-latest publication protect historical evidence and customer downloads.
verify: Mandatory pre-edit observable check: inspect the complete README.md, tools/build_course_video.py, tools/narrate_course_video.py, tools/verify_course_video.py, tools/build_video_page.py, docs/customer/video-verification.md and docs/research/final-council-review.md, plus referenced protection records. Record existing technical gates, applicable prior defects and protected-path/asset baselines. Preserve stricter applicable technical checks; the explicitly changed v3 runtime and human-watch publication standard do not retroactively change v2. Retain any newly discovered material conflict as a blocker.

Offline content check: reconcile the final project inventory against docs/customer/video-course-v3-coverage.json and docs/repository-walkthrough.md. Every inventoried path, substantive paper section and CSV profile has an explanation and valid scene/companion mapping. Reviewed minimum spoken time is met for each teaching cluster, and complete Codex script, worked-answer and distinct-visual reviews bind to the final versions.

Offline scientific check: compare parsed claims with docs/customer/evidence/uploaded-csv-profile.json, docs/customer/evidence/results.json, the results documentation and .evidence/paper-full.txt using explicit units and rounding. Require correct treatment of 1,410,255 and 79,881 CSV rows, packet versus flow inputs, compatible dataset splits, model transformations, seed accuracies 91.26%, 84.05% and 84.63%, mean 86.65%, sample SD 4.00 percentage points, and the paper's 97.50% under different conditions. Review the meaning and attribution of those quantities, not just their presence.

Offline limitations check: narration and captions explain that the uploaded CSVs are not these model training inputs, adjacent packet rows do not establish flows, the experiment is a GB10 compatibility port, checkpoint pretraining history is incomplete, softmax scores are uncalibrated, the demo replays recorded predictions, and this is not a production IDS or demonstrated live/NPU/SmartNIC deployment.

Staged media check: run the implemented verifier and complete decode against the actual v3 artifacts, recording exact invocations and outputs. Playback is 3480–3900 seconds, expected streams are present, audio diagnostics distinguish announced practice from unexpected silence, and there are no unresolved material clipping, continuity or decoding defects. Scheduled seconds alone do not pass this check.

Caption/provenance check: validate complete canonical text coverage, cue order and bounds, measured timing after all audio transformations, readable rendered layout and final source/audio/caption hashes including refreshed WAV anchors. Inspect and document rendered samples of terms, identifiers, quantities and transitions. Record the actual review method; structural validation or transcription is never described as human verification of every spoken word.

Offline page/deployment check: regenerate and freshness-check docs/customer/demo/video/index.html. In the staged site, verify playback using available browser tooling, chapter seeking, captions, transcript access and downloads. Confirm one current course and that the deployment tree excludes the retired /course/ content. Missing required browser or media checks remain visible and block readiness rather than being marked passed.

Protection check: compare before/after hashes for protected v2 evidence, archived assets and receipt, the historical customer release attachments and other protection records identified during preflight. Only the explicitly current navigation/page surfaces are switched; historical records remain unchanged.

Ordinary-root publication observation, outside the network-disabled delivery sandbox: publish additive versioned assets under course-video-v3, explicitly non-latest, after staged checks pass. Verify uploaded asset identity and that the existing latest-release customer ZIP still resolves to the same intended release and correct bundle. Switch current navigation only after these checks; then verify the deployed player, seeking, captions, transcript, downloads and continued exclusion of /course/. Record actual results in the v3 receipt.

Final status check: the v3 receipt reports only completed checks, preserves pending human full-watch/all-caption acceptance and the prior ESCALATED/UNRATIFIED outcome, and records affected lesson/reference reviews. Broker verification remains offline and staging-only; external observations and binary generation must not be represented as broker-performed actions.
